Pecos Bill.name: Pecos Bill
Pecos Bill.summary:
Pecos Bill is an reading/writing educational game related to the stories of Pecos Bill.

It contains four educational mini-games:

Nimble - The player must select homonyms, antonyms, and synonyms from a list of words.
Roll 'Em - The player must select the term that means the same as the highlighted selection in a sentence.
Willy Nilly - The player must navigate Pecos Bill through a small maze, while answering true/false questions.
Word Catcher - The player must complete sentences related to Pecos Bill before the correct word scrolls off the screen.
